newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cumberland School District, Wis..

text.p: BIDS will be received until 11:00 a.m. (Central Time) on
The Bonds will be dated November 1, 1996 and will mature serially on March 15 of each year, in the years and principal amounts as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Interest is payable semi-annually on March 15 and

September 15 of each year commencing on March 15, 1997. The Bonds are callable on March 15, 2006 and thereafter in the manner provided in the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be deemed designated as qualified tax- exempt obligations.''
The approving legal opinion of Quarles & Brady of
Milwaukee, Wisconsin and the transcript of proceedings will be furnished to the successful bidder without cost. The
Bonds, when issued, will be registered in the name of Cede & Co. as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, who will act as the securities depository of the Bonds.

Additional information including the Official Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained by addressing inquiries to: Hutchinson, Shockey, Erley & Co., 200 North Jefferson Street, Suite 100, Milwaukee, Wisconsin 53202; Attention:David W. Schott, Vice President, (414) 298-9898 or the undersigned.
